task_description: Studio won't accept my file — the browser sends it as octet-stream instead of JSON.
With a random split my validation points sit right next to training points.
I exported annotations from Studio and the features have `es_label` and `es_start_time`; olmoearth_run can't load them.
My regression-as-classification bins are wildly imbalanced after quantile binning.
My classifier flags positives everywhere — I only have target-class labels and no background.
I binned my continuous target into quartiles and got a 96 / 2.5 / 1.3 / 0.1 % class split.
My labels carry a top-level `category` field but label loading silently fails.
